ex.en: We had a history quiz this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上有歷史小考。

ex.en: We will have a math quiz tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天有數學小考。

ex.en: Let's do this fun personality quiz.
ex.zh: 我們來做這個有趣的性格測驗吧。

ex.en: She won a car on a TV quiz show.
ex.zh: 她在電視益智節目中贏得一輛車。

ex.en: We used quantitative methods to analyze the survey.
ex.zh: 我們用量化方法分析問卷。

ex.en: Quantitative data is easy to put into charts.
ex.zh: 量化資料很容易做成圖表。

ex.en: Interviews are a common qualitative research method.
ex.zh: 訪談是常見的質性研究方法。

ex.en: There is a qualitative difference between the two products.
ex.zh: 這兩種產品在本質上有差異。

ex.en: She's made up her mind to quit the company.
ex.zh: 她已經下定決心要離開公司。

ex.en: Tom said that he's considered quitting his job.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他考慮過辭職。

ex.en: He quit his job to start his own business.
ex.zh: 他辭職自己創業。

ex.en: He quit smoking for the sake of his health.
ex.zh: 他為了健康戒了菸。

ex.en: Quit smoking if you don't want to die early.
ex.zh: 如果你不想早死，就把菸戒掉。

ex.en: We'll go when it quits raining.
ex.zh: 等雨停了我們就出發。

ex.en: Please fill out this short questionnaire.
ex.zh: 請填寫這份簡短的問卷。

ex.en: We sent the questionnaire to 500 customers.
ex.zh: 我們把問卷寄給了五百位顧客。

ex.en: The company released its quarterly report.
ex.zh: 公司公布了季報。

ex.en: Quarterly sales rose by 10 percent.
ex.zh: 本季銷售額成長了百分之十。

ex.en: Taxes are paid quarterly.
ex.zh: 稅款按季繳納。

ex.en: The team meets quarterly to review goals.
ex.zh: 團隊每季開會檢討目標。

ex.en: Any further queries should be made via the customer service number below.
ex.zh: 如有其他疑問，請撥打下方的客服電話。

ex.en: If you have any queries, please contact our support team.
ex.zh: 如有任何疑問，請聯絡我們的客服團隊。

ex.en: The customer queried the charges on her bill.
ex.zh: 顧客對帳單上的費用提出疑問。

ex.en: Several staff members queried the new policy.
ex.zh: 有幾位員工對新政策提出質疑。

ex.en: The database query took too long to run.
ex.zh: 這個資料庫查詢執行得太久了。

ex.en: Write a query to find all orders from last month.
ex.zh: 寫一個查詢找出上個月所有的訂單。

ex.en: I've reached my sales quota for this month.
ex.zh: 我已達成這個月的業績目標。

ex.en: The country has an import quota on rice.
ex.zh: 這個國家對稻米設有進口配額。

ex.en: The queue for buying tickets was unbelievably long.
ex.zh: 買票的隊伍長得不可思議。

ex.en: A long queue had formed in front of the shop.
ex.zh: 店門口排起了長長的人龍。

ex.en: I hate people cutting queues.
ex.zh: 我討厭插隊的人。

ex.en: "But I'm already queuing," I tell him.
ex.zh: 「可是我已經在排隊了。」我跟他說。

ex.en: We queued for an hour to get tickets.
ex.zh: 我們排了一小時的隊才買到票。

ex.en: There are five documents in the print queue.
ex.zh: 列印佇列裡有五份文件。

ex.en: Your request has been added to the queue.
ex.zh: 你的請求已加入等候清單。

ex.en: It's hard to quantify the benefits of training.
ex.zh: 訓練的好處很難量化。

ex.en: Can you quantify the risk?
ex.zh: 你能把風險量化嗎？

ex.en: The agency is a quasi-government organization.
ex.zh: 這個機構是準政府組織。

ex.en: The team works as a quasi-independent unit.
ex.zh: 這個小組以半獨立的單位運作。

ex.en: It is difficult for me to answer the question.
ex.zh: 這個問題對我來說很難回答。

ex.en: Do I have to answer all of the questions?
ex.zh: 我需要回答所有問題嗎？

ex.en: Tom was questioned by the police.
ex.zh: 湯姆被警方盤問。

ex.en: The police questioned the witness for hours.
ex.zh: 警方盤問了證人好幾個小時。

ex.en: Nobody questioned his decision.
ex.zh: 沒有人質疑他的決定。

ex.en: I question whether this plan will work.
ex.zh: 我懷疑這個計畫行不行得通。

ex.en: What we had to do was really quite simple.
ex.zh: 我們要做的事其實相當簡單。

ex.en: The hotel was quite expensive.
ex.zh: 那家飯店相當貴。

quite.zh: 完全、十分（常用於否定：not quite 不太）

ex.en: The two brothers are quite unlike in their appearance.
ex.zh: 那兩兄弟長得完全不像。

ex.en: I'm not quite sure what you mean.
ex.zh: 我不太確定你的意思。

quite.zh: quite a few / quite a lot：相當多

ex.en: During this process, I answered quite a few questions.
ex.zh: 在這個過程中，我回答了好幾個問題。

ex.en: Quite a lot of friends and acquaintances have come.
ex.zh: 來了相當多的朋友和熟人。

ex.en: The body quickly adjusts itself to changes in temperature.
ex.zh: 人體能很快適應氣溫的變化。

ex.en: You'll get used to the dorm life pretty quickly.
ex.zh: 你很快就會習慣宿舍生活。

ex.en: Yanni quickly grabbed the PC and left the room.
ex.zh: 雅尼迅速抓起電腦，離開了房間。

ex.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
ex.zh: 企業第一季的獲利大幅改善。

ex.en: Sales fell off in the third quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季的銷售額下滑了。

ex.en: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季我們的盈餘成長了將近一成。

ex.en: A quarter of the staff work from home.
ex.zh: 四分之一的員工在家工作。

ex.en: Cut the cake into quarters.
ex.zh: 把蛋糕切成四等份。

ex.en: I have my supper at a quarter past seven.
ex.zh: 我七點十五分吃晚餐。

ex.en: It happened at a quarter past eleven.
ex.zh: 事情發生在十一點十五分。

ex.en: The quickest means of travel is by plane.
ex.zh: 最快的交通方式是搭飛機。

ex.en: Flying is the quickest method of travelling.
ex.zh: 搭飛機是最快的旅行方式。

ex.en: The old man set off at a quick trot.
ex.zh: 老人快步離開。

ex.en: Can I ask you a quick question?
ex.zh: 我可以問你一個簡單的問題嗎？

ex.en: Let's have a quick meeting before lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐前我們開個簡短的會吧。

ex.en: She is a quick learner.
ex.zh: 她學得很快。

ex.en: He is quick to spot problems.
ex.zh: 他很快就能發現問題。

ex.en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.
ex.zh: 聽演講時應該保持安靜。

ex.en: Be quiet, or the baby will wake up.
ex.zh: 安靜點，不然寶寶會醒來。

ex.en: He's a quiet man, a little bald on top.
ex.zh: 他是個文靜的人，頭頂有點禿。

ex.en: Business is usually quiet in January.
ex.zh: 一月的生意通常很清淡。

ex.en: We had a quiet weekend at home.
ex.zh: 我們在家度過了一個平靜的週末。

ex.en: The mother was quieting her crying baby.
ex.zh: 媽媽正在安撫哭鬧的寶寶。

ex.en: The teacher quieted the noisy class.
ex.zh: 老師讓吵鬧的全班安靜下來。

qualify.zh: 使具備資格、能勝任（be qualified for）

ex.en: Do you think I'm qualified for that job?
ex.zh: 你覺得我能勝任那份工作嗎？

ex.en: He is not qualified for the job.
ex.zh: 他不夠格做這份工作。

ex.en: Aren't there any qualified applicants?
ex.zh: 沒有任何合格的應徵者嗎？

qualify.zh: 取得資格；符合條件、晉級

ex.en: She is qualified as a nurse.
ex.zh: 她具有護理師資格。

ex.en: Our team qualified for the final round.
ex.zh: 我們隊晉級了決賽。

ex.en: You may qualify for a discount if you're a student.
ex.zh: 如果你是學生，可能符合打折的資格。

ex.en: Tom quietly opened the door and tiptoed into the room.
ex.zh: 湯姆悄悄打開門，躡手躡腳走進房間。

ex.en: He read a book quietly, as though nothing had happened.
ex.zh: 他安靜地讀著書，彷彿什麼事都沒發生。

ex.en: Jim entered the room quietly so he wouldn't wake the baby.
ex.zh: 吉姆悄悄走進房間，以免吵醒寶寶。

ex.en: Quantum computers could solve problems much faster.
ex.zh: 量子電腦能更快速地解決問題。

ex.en: He studies quantum physics at university.
ex.zh: 他在大學研究量子物理。

ex.en: The new technology is a quantum leap for the industry.
ex.zh: 這項新技術是業界的一大突破。

ex.en: Our sales made a quantum leap this year.
ex.zh: 我們今年的銷售額大幅躍進。

ex.en: He is really a queer fellow!
ex.zh: 他可真是個怪人！

ex.en: He has queer ideas.
ex.zh: 他有著奇妙的想法。

ex.en: There was a queer smell coming from the basement.
ex.zh: 地下室傳來一股怪味。

ex.en: It is questionable whether this data can be relied on.
ex.zh: 這些資料未必可靠。

ex.en: The company's accounting methods are questionable.
ex.zh: 那家公司的會計做法有疑問。

ex.en: The ground began to quake under our feet.
ex.zh: 我們腳下的地面開始震動。

ex.en: He quaked with fear when he heard footsteps behind him.
ex.zh: 他聽到背後有腳步聲時嚇得發抖。

ex.en: A strong quake shook the city at dawn.
ex.zh: 黎明時分一場強烈地震撼動了這座城市。

ex.en: Many buildings were damaged by the quake.
ex.zh: 許多建築物在地震中受損。

ex.en: Every product goes through strict quality control.
ex.zh: 每項產品都經過嚴格的品管。

ex.en: She works in quality control at a food factory.
ex.zh: 她在一家食品工廠做品管。

ex.en: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
ex.zh: 這張地毯的品質比那張好得多。

ex.en: Japanese companies have built up a reputation for quality.
ex.zh: 日本企業已經建立了品質好的聲譽。

ex.en: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.
ex.zh: 這幾年空氣品質變差了。

ex.en: I believe you already possess all the qualities needed to go undercover.
ex.zh: 我相信你已經具備臥底需要的所有特質。

ex.en: Patience is an important quality for a teacher.
ex.zh: 耐心是老師的重要特質。

ex.en: This area has been quarantined.
ex.zh: 這個地區已經被隔離了。

ex.en: All travelers had to quarantine for 14 days.
ex.zh: 所有旅客都必須隔離檢疫 14 天。

ex.en: The dog was kept in quarantine for a month.
ex.zh: 那隻狗被隔離檢疫了一個月。

ex.en: Animals must go through quarantine before entering the country.
ex.zh: 動物入境前必須經過檢疫。

ex.en: Could you send us a quote for 500 units?
ex.zh: 可以給我們 500 件的報價嗎？

ex.en: We got three quotes before choosing a supplier.
ex.zh: 我們比較了三份報價才選定供應商。

ex.en: He often quotes from Shakespeare.
ex.zh: 他經常引用莎士比亞。

ex.en: Your Chinese is so good, you can quote proverbs.
ex.zh: 你的中文真好，都能引用俗語了。

ex.en: Where does this quote come from?
ex.zh: 這句引言出自哪裡？

ex.en: She started her speech with a famous quote.
ex.zh: 她以一句名言作為演講的開場。

ex.en: Please send me a quotation by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前寄報價單給我。

ex.en: The quotation is valid for thirty days.
ex.zh: 這份報價單有效期為三十天。

ex.en: The book begins with a quotation from Confucius.
ex.zh: 這本書以一段孔子的話開頭。

ex.en: Put the quotation in quotation marks.
ex.zh: 把引文放在引號裡。

ex.en: However, the quantity was not correct.
ex.zh: 但是，數量不對。

ex.en: Quality is more important than quantity.
ex.zh: 品質比數量更重要。

ex.en: A large quantity of air-conditioners has been sold since the temperature is high.
ex.zh: 因為氣溫很高，冷氣賣出了很多台。

ex.en: We can't vote because we don't have a quorum.
ex.zh: 我們沒有達到法定人數，所以不能表決。

ex.en: A quorum of five members is needed to make decisions.
ex.zh: 需要五位成員出席才達到做決定的法定人數。

ex.en: What qualifications do I need for this job?
ex.zh: 這份工作需要什麼資格？

ex.en: She has a teaching qualification from the UK.
ex.zh: 她有英國的教師資格證。
